    Morphism depth as a rank for ray-path interlacement #

    The maximal length of an irreducible-path presentation of a nonzero ray morphism is constant on related paths and strictly increases after adding a proper common whisker. It therefore supplies the rank used at the end of Roiter's clinging argument.
